SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DISTINCT SV01.DEAL_STTMN_NO FROM KEPCON.KEPMPSV01 SV01, KEPCON.KEPMPSV02 SV02 WHERE SV01.CSTMR_ID = 'KRSSAN0025C001' AND SV01.DEAL_STTMN_NO = SV02.DEAL_STTMN_NO AND SV01.SND_CHK = 'N' AND TRIM(SV01.CSTMR_DEAL_STTMN_NO) IS NOT NULL
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT SO04.IF_ORDR_BIZNPLC_CD AS PLANT ,SV01.CSTMR_DEAL_STTMN_NO AS LEGACY_IV_NO ,SV02.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ AS LEGACY_IV_SEQ ,DECODE(SV02.USE_CHK,'N','D','C') AS STATUS ,SO06.IF_ORDR_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO ,SO06.IF_ORDR_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,SV02.GDS_CD AS BUYER_ITEM_NO ,SV02.DLVRY_QTY AS ITEM_QTY ,SV01.DLVRY_DATE AS INV_DATE FROM KEPCON.KEPMPSV01 SV01, KEPCON.KEPMPSV02 SV02, KEPCON.KEPMPSO06 SO06, KEPCON.KEPMPSO04 SO04 WHERE SV01.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID' AND SV01.DEAL_STTMN_NO = '$G_RS.DEAL_STTMN_NO$' AND SV01.SND_CHK = 'N' AND SV01.DEAL_STTMN_NO = SV02.DEAL_STTMN_NO AND SV02.SND_CHK = 'N' AND SV02.ORDR_NO = SO06.ORDR_NO AND SV02.ORDR_SEQ= SO06.ORDR_SEQ AND SO06.CSTMR_ID = SO04.CSTMR_ID AND SO06.ORDR_RE_NO = SO04.ORDR_RE_NO AND SO06.ORDR_RE_SEQ= SO04.ORDR_RE_SEQ ORDER BY PLANT, LEGACY_IV_NO, LEGACY_IV_SEQ
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPMPSV01 SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE DEAL_STTMN_NO = '$G_RS.DEAL_STTMN_NO$' AND SND_CHK = 'N'
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPMPSV01 SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE DEAL_STTMN_NO = '$G_RS.DEAL_STTMN_NO$' AND SND_CHK = 'N'
